title: Project scope — the flow a project is sized by and its project type
description: Written by concept-scope. The file records what was decided and nothing else, so the top level is closed.

flow.description: The flow is the sizing. The four names are the whole vocabulary.

project_type.description: A row of tree/01_meta/scope.md § Project types; unset reads as web-app.

reasoning.description: Two to six sentences naming which signals decided the flow.

chosen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the decision.

signals.description: Each answer as the user gave it; the reasoning quotes these values.

features_estimate.description: How many distinct things a user can do.

multi_user.description: Whether more than one role shares state.

persistence.description: How data is persisted: none, one relational schema, or an external store the project does not own.
